title: Connected model originals capabilities, exact draft.30
description: Structural capability document for the connected server/client contract. Binding and language additionally require 1 to 128 decoded UTF-8 bytes. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points and does not establish that byte rule; the shared capability decoder must enforce it. No capability document establishes source lineage, producer authority or qualification

binding.description: Require 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes of decoded text, with no normalization; maxLength is a necessary structural check only

language.description: Require 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes of decoded text, with no normalization; maxLength is a necessary structural check only
